title: Image Carousel
description: Build an image carousel that navigates through a list of images with next/previous controls.

steps.title: Image array with titles
steps.description: Create an array of image objects with `url`, `title`, and `id` properties. Include at least 3 items.
hints: Each object should have url, title, and id fields

codeTemplate.python:
images = [
    # Your code here
]
import json
print(json.dumps(images))

verification.failureMessage: Include url, title, and id for at least 3 images.

steps.title: nextImage function
steps.description: Write `nextImage()` that increments the current index by 1 and logs the new image title.
hints: Track currentIndex as a variable outside the function
Log the title of the new current image

verification.failureMessage: Make sure nextImage increments the index and logs the title.

steps.title: prevImage function
steps.description: Write `prevImage()` that decrements the current index by 1 and logs the new image title.
hints: Handle negative index by wrapping to the last image

verification.failureMessage: Make sure prevImage decrements the index with wrap-around.

steps.title: currentSlide display
steps.description: Write `currentSlide()` that returns a formatted string showing the current position: `'Slide X of Y: [title]'`.

verification.failureMessage: Return 'Slide X of Y: title' format.

steps.title: Wrap-around logic
steps.description: Ensure `nextImage` wraps from the last image to the first, and `prevImage` wraps from the first to the last. Log `'Wrapped!'` when wrapping occurs.
hints: Check if currentIndex === images.length - 1 before incrementing
Set index to 0 or images.length - 1 respectively

verification.failureMessage: Log 'Wrapped!' when wrapping from last to first image.
